Variants.Content: The Loloseni family has its roots in the urban society of Qohor. The great forests bring wood, hides and dangers, the workshops create expensive metal goods, and the Black Goat Sacrifice brings sanctity and fear to the city's power. If Loloseni wanted to maintain their influence, they had to maintain functioning relationships among merchants, priests, craftsmen, and those who wielded force. Located on the edge of the Great Forest, Qohor is known for its blacksmiths who can reforge Valyrian steel, color metal, and the faith of the Black Goat. The city's wealth comes from forests, workshops, caravans and slave labor, while religious sacrifices and industry secrets combine to shape its dark reputation.
Entry Loloseni If a family offends industry secrets or religious authorities, no matter how much money they spend, they may lose their foothold in the city.
Entry Loloseni When outsiders admire colored steel, they rarely think of how many people around the fire inhale smoke and dust all year round.

Entry Loloseni Loloseni is the sect of the Qhor family, and the family business is shaped by the great forest, the Black Goat Temple, the metallurgical workshops and the long-distance trade routes. The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
